name: AI Automod
description: AI deletes spam, scams and insults from new members and logs them for your moderators.
about: The bot checks the messages of members who joined in the last 7 days with AI, and deletes spam, scams, unwanted ads and insults. Every message it deletes is posted in your log channel with who sent it and where, so moderators can see what the AI removed.

The AI only deletes a message when it's at least 90% sure that it breaks the rules. Messages it's less sure about stay up and go to the log channel with a link, so a moderator can decide. You can add rules of your own, like no links to other servers, and they're checked together with the default ones.

Each check costs 1 credit. Spam bots and raiders are usually new to the server, so checking only new members keeps the cost low. To check everyone, remove the condition at the top of the event listener.

faq.question: Which AI model does it use?
faq.answer: Jev by TypeSafe, a model made for decisions instead of chat. It answers with how likely it is that a message breaks the rules, and the AI Check block compares that with its thresholds.

faq.question: How many credits does it use?
faq.answer: 1 credit for every message it checks. Messages of bots, of members who joined more than 7 days ago and without text are skipped and cost nothing. Deleting a message and posting it in the log channel cost 1 credit each.

faq.question: Can the AI make mistakes?
faq.answer: Yes, which is why it only deletes messages it's very sure about and sends the rest to your moderators. Raise the yes threshold of the AI Check block above 0.9 to delete fewer messages, or lower it to delete more.

faq.question: Can it time out members?
faq.answer: Not out of the box. Add a Timeout member block after the block that deletes the message, so members whose message the AI deletes are timed out too.

faq.question: What permissions does the bot need?
faq.answer: Manage Messages in the channels it checks, and Send Messages and Embed Links in the log channel.

faq.question: Do I need the Message Content Intent?
faq.answer: Yes. Turn it on under Bot in the Discord Developer Portal, or the bot can't read the messages it checks.

setup: Turn on the Message Content Intent under Bot in the Discord Developer Portal, so the bot can read the messages.
